stem: Vestigial organ ____ present in human body is proof of evolution.
solution: The vermiform appendix is a vestigial organ in the human body. It is a functionless remnant of the caecum which was well developed and useful in herbivorous ancestors. Its presence is anatomical evidence of evolution. (Human hand is a functional homologous organ, while ear muscles and tail-bone are also vestigial but the classic textbook example asked here is the appendix.)

chapter: Life Processes in Living Organisms Part 2
solution: Gamete formation (formation of male and female gametes followed by their fusion) is a feature of sexual reproduction. Fragmentation, regeneration and budding are all methods of asexual reproduction that do not involve gametes.

In a food chain grasshopper (primary consumer) is eaten by frog, frog by snake, and snake by eagle. The eagle is at the top of the food chain and is not eaten by any other consumer, so the eagle is the apex (top) consumer.

stem: The Hydroelectric capacity of Koyna dam is ____.
solution: The Koyna hydroelectric project in Maharashtra has a total installed generating capacity of 1960 MW, making it one of the largest hydroelectric power plants in India.

Human body can be divided into two equal (mirror-image) halves by only one median plane, so it shows bilateral symmetry. Adult star fish shows radial symmetry, Paramoecium is asymmetrical, and Amoeba has no definite symmetry.

stem: State whether the following statement is true or false: To take selfie on road is the invitation for accident.
solution: True. Taking a selfie on a road or at a dangerous place distracts attention and puts the person in the path of vehicles or in a risky spot, which can easily cause a serious or fatal accident. Hence it is an invitation for accident.

stem: Write the correct co-relation: Insulin : diabetes :: Interferon : ____.
solution: Interferon : viral infections (viral diseases). Just as insulin is used to treat diabetes, interferon is a protein produced by biotechnology that is used to treat viral infections (and certain cancers).

stem: To which class does bat belong?
solution: Bat belongs to Class Mammalia. Although it can fly, it has mammary glands, hair on the body and gives birth to young ones, so it is a mammal.
